purpose: Evidence closure contract for all P0 work items required by the final architecture gate.
rule: A P0 item may move to PASS only when the required evidence is produced, machine-verifiable, tied to a reviewed release head, and accepted by the affected gate.

items.title: Green Architecture Gate
items.verification: Architecture Gate workflow on the exact release head
items.acceptance: No failed, skipped, or stale required stage
items.blocker: Canonical repository is not currently readable through the connected GitHub integration.

items.title: Verify host-level branch protection
items.acceptance: Protection is independently verifiable on the release branch
items.blocker: Host-level branch protection cannot be independently read from the current connection.

items.title: Canonical CRM evidence
items.acceptance: Evidence proves canonical customer/business state without synthetic success
items.blocker: Production-grade CRM source and execution evidence are not currently accessible for verification.

items.title: Production provider evidence
items.acceptance: Provider behavior is reproducible and traceable against approved production-like targets

items.title: Real provider connectivity
items.acceptance: Connectivity and recovery are proven rather than inferred from mocks

items.title: Production transaction proof
items.acceptance: Observe -> Decide -> Approve -> Execute -> Verify is fully traceable

items.title: Production security evidence
items.acceptance: No raw secret exposure and consequential failure paths remain fail-closed
